This is Déjà. It gives a testing agent a memory.
Testing agents call the AI model on every run, even when nothing changed.
The first time, Kimi K3.1 Pro on Cerebras tests the checkout through OpenClaw. It takes thirteen model calls.
Déjà runs the new test again. It saves it only if all fourteen checks pass.
After that, each run replays the saved test. Zero model calls.
Then a button ID changed. Déjà made one small fix, and showed the change.
If the app itself breaks, the test still fails. Déjà never hides a real bug.
Here, the fixed test passes again.
Déjà. Built with Kimi on Cerebras, and OpenClaw.
